title: Kubernetes Architecture
summary: Why Kubernetes exists, how desired state and reconciliation loops work, and what every control-plane and node component actually does when you run `kubectl apply`.
objectives: Explain declarative desired state and how controllers reconcile actual state towards it
Describe the job of kube-apiserver, etcd, the scheduler, kube-controller-manager and cloud-controller-manager
Describe the job of the kubelet, the container runtime (CRI/containerd) and kube-proxy
Walk through every step between `kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml` and a running container
Read any API object by its apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec and status
Use namespaces, labels, selectors and annotations correctly
Explore the Kubernetes API directly with `kubectl get --raw`, `kubectl proxy`, `api-resources` and `explain`
